plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for BKTel HFC862 cable/HFC network elements with NECE modules (enterprise PEN 7501). It reports uptime, left/right power supply and fan status per slot, and interface traffic.
name: Transmission

metrics.name: device_psu_state

dimensions.name: position
dimensions.description: Unit position seen from the front: left or right

metrics.description: Status of the left and right power supply units of each BKTel HFC862 NECE slot (BKTEL-HFC862-NECE-MIB neceStatesPowerSupplyLeft/Right, 1.3.6.1.4.1.7501.1.2.100.2.1.1.13/.14). notification(0) and clear(5) are normal (1); alarm(2), warning(3) and any other value are abnormal (2). Only 2G6 systems report real values; other systems always report clear(5).

metrics.name: device_fan_state

dimensions.name: position
dimensions.description: Unit position seen from the front: left or right

metrics.description: Status of the left and right fan units of each BKTel HFC862 NECE slot (neceStatesFanLeft/Right, 1.3.6.1.4.1.7501.1.2.100.2.1.1.15/.16). notification(0) and clear(5) are normal (1); alarm(2), warning(3) and any other value are abnormal (2). Only 2G6 systems report real values; other systems always report clear(5).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCInOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, based on the 64-bit ifHCOutOctets counter which does not wrap on high-speed interfaces.

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
